item.rsadvanced.infinite_cell.help: Insert into a Refined Storage Disk Drive to provide an infinite supply of the specified resource. Accepts the same resource back without accumulating it.
block.rsadvanced.network_anchor.help: Keeps connected RS chunks loaded in this dimension. Consumes FE from the RS network each tick.
